class Base {
  set value(value: number) { console.log(typeof this, value); }
}
class Derived extends Base {
  write() { super.value = 1; }
  writeIndex() { super["value"] = 2; }
}
Derived.prototype.write.call(3);
Derived.prototype.writeIndex.call("s");
Derived.prototype.write.call(undefined);
Derived.prototype.writeIndex.call(null);
